'''Chola Mavra''' was a floating [[City/Legends|city]], located in the upper atmosphere of the gas [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

==Description==
Chola Mavra was very informal in style. It was arranged so that there were neat, rectangular blocks of buildings. It was the site of many conference buildings.

==History==
During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] met with the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in Chola Mavra, and she requested that they investigate a plot to stop her upcoming [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] to [[Jarid DeBell]].
